pricing.q: Can I start with an idea, and what does design cost?
pricing.a: Start with a Pinterest photo, a rough idea or existing drawings. We consult, measure and develop the design and technical specification with you. Furniture 3D design and technical drawings: 30 GEL/m², calculated by front elevation. Full interior design: US$15–20/m², calculated by floor area. Design fees are separate from manufacturing. The furniture quotation follows consultation, 3D design and technical specification. The price is fixed for the agreed specification; customer-requested design or material revisions during review are re-estimated and approved before production.

timeline.q: How long does a project take, and when is the price fixed?
timeline.a: Plan approximately 6–8 weeks, around two months, overall. This is an estimate; reviews, workload, season and additional finishing can extend it. Approximately one week for the initial design. Approximately 7–10 days for drawings, detail review and approval. Requested revisions can change the design and quote. Approximately 5–14 days for preparation, precision cutting and edge-banding through specialist suppliers and processing providers, depending on workload and season. Approximately one week. Painted MDF can add 7–10 days; CNC routing can add around five days. We confirm the schedule for your specification.

materials.q: How do we choose materials and finishes?
materials.a: We source materials and processing services from LTB, Imeri, Geo Decor, Ionfasha, Kasta (including Kronospan materials) and Oldlami (including Starwood materials). These are suppliers and service providers. Specific materials and availability are confirmed for each project. Our capabilities include CNC routing, laser cutting, custom metal structures and decor, laser metal welding and electrostatic powder coating. Specialist processing is arranged where required.

kitchens.title: Custom kitchens in Tbilisi
kitchens.metaTitle: Custom kitchens in Tbilisi | Kencho Group
kitchens.metaDescription: Custom kitchen manufacturing, from an inspiration photo to fitted cabinetry. Design, materials, delivery and installation throughout Georgia.
kitchens.lede: Custom kitchen manufacturing, from an inspiration photo to fitted cabinetry. Design, materials, delivery and installation throughout Georgia.
kitchens.focus: We develop the cabinet layout, appliance spaces, storage, fronts and worktop details around your room. Bring a Pinterest reference or your designer’s drawings; the final specification determines the manufacturing quote.
kitchens.faq1q: Can we start with a Pinterest kitchen photograph?
kitchens.faq1a: Yes. We use the photograph to understand the style, then review your room, dimensions, appliance requirements, materials and technical drawings before agreeing what will be made.
kitchens.faq2q: Does the design fee include manufacturing?
kitchens.faq2a: No. Furniture 3D design and technical drawings cost 30 GEL/m² of front elevation. Full interior design costs US$15–20/m² of floor area. Manufacturing, delivery and installation are priced in the separate agreed project quote.

wardrobes-storage.focus: We review depth, height, door movement, hanging space, drawers and everyday storage needs. The approved design and materials define the technical drawings and quote.
wardrobes-storage.faq1q: Can you design storage for an awkward space?
